name: Colin O'Brien
about_me: I'm Colin, founder of Shiftly, a marketplace that fills open nursing shifts at small hospitals. We're in two hospitals in Michigan. I need nurse advisors and intros to hospital operations leaders.
goals: Sign three more hospitals to Shiftly

debriefs.text: Andre Williams, an ED nurse at Michigan Medicine, gave us blunt feedback on the app. He said nurses want to see pay before accepting a shift.
Talked to Bethany Kowalski, ED nurse manager. She said Michigan Medicine won't use outside staffing apps, but she'd advise informally.
Met Ravi Menon, Ann Arbor angel, who said he likes staffing marketplaces and asked for our retention numbers. I promised to send them Monday.
Esther Wu from Stryker BD knows hospital COOs across the state and offered to make two intros if we get a case study.
Carmen Diaz, a pediatric NP, said rural hospitals are desperate for shift coverage.

card.headline: Founder, Shiftly
card.about: Fills open nursing shifts at small hospitals.

request.need: Experienced nurses willing to advise a nurse-staffing startup
request.about_line: Founder of a nursing-shift marketplace live in two Michigan hospitals
